title: 第21课 · 你去哪儿了
subtitle: Lesson 21 — 你去哪儿了 · Where did you go

items.py: Nǐ zuótiān qù nǎr le?
items.en: Where did you go yesterday?

items.py: Wǒ qù shūdiàn mǎi shū le.
items.en: I went to the bookstore to buy books.

items.py: Nǐ mǎi le shénme?
items.en: What did you buy?

items.zh: 我买了一本词典和两本小说。
items.py: Wǒ mǎi le yī běn cídiǎn hé liǎng běn xiǎoshuō.
items.en: I bought a dictionary and two novels.

items.py: Xīngqītiān nǐ zuò le shénme?
items.en: What did you do on Sunday?

items.zh: 我跟朋友一起去公园了。
items.py: Wǒ gēn péngyou yīqǐ qù gōngyuán le.
items.en: I went to the park with friends.

items.zh: 你在北京住了多长时间？
items.py: Nǐ zài Běijīng zhù le duō cháng shíjiān?
items.en: How long did you live in Beijing?

items.zh: 刘京：大卫，昨天你去哪儿了？我给你打电话，你不在。
items.py: Liú Jīng: Dàwèi, zuótiān nǐ qù nǎr le? Wǒ gěi nǐ dǎ diànhuà, nǐ bú zài.
items.en: Liu Jing: David, where did you go yesterday? I called, you weren't in.

items.py: Dàwèi: Wǒ qù shūdiàn mǎi shū le.
items.en: David: I went to the bookstore.

items.py: Liú Jīng: Nǐ mǎi le shénme?
items.en: Liu Jing: What did you buy?

items.zh: 大卫：我买了一本词典和两本小说。
items.py: Dàwèi: Wǒ mǎi le yī běn cídiǎn hé liǎng běn xiǎoshuō.
items.en: David: A dictionary and two novels.

items.py: Liú Jīng: Shénme xiǎoshuō?
items.en: Liu Jing: What novels?

items.zh: 大卫：一本中文的，一本英文的。中文的太难了，我看不懂。
items.py: Dàwèi: Yī běn Zhōngwén de, yī běn Yīngwén de. Zhōngwén de tài nán le, wǒ kàn bu dǒng.
items.en: David: One Chinese, one English. The Chinese one is too hard, I can't understand it.

items.py: Liú Jīng: Mànman kàn, bié zhāojí.
items.en: Liu Jing: Read slowly, don't rush.

items.zh: 和子：星期天你做了什么？
items.py: Hézǐ: Xīngqītiān nǐ zuò le shénme?
items.en: Hezi: What did you do on Sunday?

items.zh: 玛丽：我跟朋友一起去公园了。
items.py: Mǎlì: Wǒ gēn péngyou yīqǐ qù gōngyuán le.
items.en: Mary: I went to the park with friends.

items.zh: 和子：你们在那儿做了什么？
items.py: Hézǐ: Nǐmen zài nàr zuò le shénme?
items.en: Hezi: What did you do there?

items.zh: 玛丽：我们照了很多照片，还划了船。
items.py: Mǎlì: Wǒmen zhào le hěn duō zhàopiàn, hái huá le chuán.
items.en: Mary: We took lots of photos and went boating.

items.py: Hézǐ: Tīng qǐlái hěn yǒu yìsi.
items.en: Hezi: Sounds very interesting.

items.zh: 玛丽：是啊，你星期天做了什么？
items.py: Mǎlì: Shì a, nǐ xīngqītiān zuò le shénme?
items.en: Mary: Yes, what did you do on Sunday?

items.zh: 和子：我在宿舍看了一天的书。
items.py: Hézǐ: Wǒ zài sùshè kàn le yī tiān de shū.
items.en: Hezi: I spent the whole day reading in the dorm.

items.py: Wǒ mǎi le yī běn shū.
items.en: I bought a book. (了 after verb = completed)

items.py: Tā chī le zǎofàn jiù zǒu le.
items.en: He left after eating breakfast.

items.py: Wǒ méiyǒu mǎi cídiǎn.
items.en: I didn't buy a dictionary. (没有, no 了)

items.py: Nǐ qù le méiyǒu? —— Méi qù.
items.en: Did you go? — No.

items.py: Zuótiān xià le yī tiān de yǔ.
items.en: It rained all day yesterday.

items.zh: 你昨天去哪儿了？——我去书店了。
items.py: Nǐ zuótiān qù nǎr le? —— Wǒ qù shūdiàn le.
items.en: Where did you go? — To the bookstore.

items.zh: 你昨天去哪儿了？——我去超市了。
items.py: Nǐ zuótiān qù nǎr le? —— Wǒ qù chāoshì le.
items.en: Where did you go? — To the supermarket.

items.zh: 你昨天去哪儿了？——我去朋友家了。
items.py: Nǐ zuótiān qù nǎr le? —— Wǒ qù péngyou jiā le.
items.en: Where did you go? — To a friend's house.

items.zh: 星期天你做了什么？——我逛商店了。
items.py: Xīngqītiān nǐ zuò le shénme? —— Wǒ guàng shāngdiàn le.
items.en: What did you do Sunday? — I went shopping.

items.zh: 星期天你做了什么？——我看电影了。
items.py: Xīngqītiān nǐ zuò le shénme? —— Wǒ kàn diànyǐng le.
items.en: What did you do Sunday? — I watched a movie.

items.zh: 星期天你做了什么？——我上网了。
items.py: Xīngqītiān nǐ zuò le shénme? —— Wǒ shàng wǎng le.
items.en: What did you do Sunday? — I went online.
